subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — packaging & pilot

Subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — packaging & pilot

Hi Priyanka,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on your tracing needs for the new ECG ingestion pipeline. We discussed three add-on surfaces: long-term retention, high-fidelity tracing, and the advanced dashboard pack. To make procurement easier, I put together three packaging approaches in the attached PDF (Acme-Observability-Options-v1.pdf):

- Basic meter: per-GB storage + per-1000 trace spans sampled; 30-day retention default.
- Standard bundle: 90-day retention, low-cost cold archival, 1k dashboard seats, basic trace sampling rules.
- Enterprise retention: 365-day hot/cold tiering, full trace capture for priority services, 5k dashboard seats, SLA for retrieval times.

A few clarifying points we said we'd follow up on:
- EU data residency (we can host retention & archives in eu-central).
- Retrieval latency SLA for archived logs (target < 2 hours for archive, < 60s for warm storage).
- Pricing for trace ingestion vs storage (we separate span ingestion and long-term storage).

Can you confirm which packaging model you'd like us to price in detail? If helpful, we can propose a 3-month pilot (credits to offset ingestion) so your infra team can validate retrieval latency and dashboard response under realistic load.

Attached: Acme-Observability-Options-v1.pdf (pricing scenarios), TL;DR one-pager in page 2.

Next steps proposed:
1) You confirm pilot scope (services to capture, retention window)
2) We send a short SOW + pilot credit proposal and a draft order form
3) Internal procurement review / PO — we can accept DocuSign or standard PO.

Would love to lock in a follow-up next Tuesday to align on scope.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0132

Procurement timeline: we aim to sign pilot paperwork within 2 weeks if the numbers look reasonable. Also: are you able to waive the 10-seat minimum for dashboards for pilot?

Hi Priyanka — thanks for the SOQ. I pulled together a short pricing scenarios breakdown below (numbers illustrative; final will be in the SOW):

Scenario A — Pilot (3 months)
- One-time setup & EU tenancy: $8,000
- Ingestion: $0.80 per million spans ingested (first 50M covered by pilot credits)
- Storage: $0.025 per GB / month for warm, $0.004 per GB / month for cold archive
- Dashboards: waived seat-minimum for pilot (we'll provide up to 5 seats at no charge)
- Tracing fidelity: sampled full-span capture for 10 priority services; lower-sample for others
- Pilot credits offered: $15,000 (applies to ingestion & storage only)

Scenario B — Annual Standard Commit (12-month)
- Volume tiers: 0-1TB mo: baseline rates; 1-5TB mo: -12% on storage; >5TB mo: -22% on storage
- Commit discounts: 12% off list for a 100k USD annual commit to add-ons (applies to bundles)
- Dashboard pricing: $6/user/month, seat minimum 10 unless waived in negotiated SOW

Scenario C — Enterprise Retention (custom)
- 365d hot/cold tiering, SLA retrieval: $0.045 per GB/month hot + $0.006 cold; SLA for warm retrieval: 60s; archive retrieval: 90-120 minutes
- Enterprise discount path available with multi-year commit and Dedicated capacity purchase

Other clarifications:
- Data residency: EU tenancy means no replication of telemetry to US by default; cross-region replication is an opt-in feature and will be explicit in the SOW.
- SLA & credits: Retrieval SLA will be in the SOW; standard SLA credits apply for missed targets.
- DocuSign: I'll include a short pilot order form + SOW template. HubSpot deal id: ACME-2027-OBS-42.

If these heuristics look on target, Marcus can prepare a short SOW + pilot order form (DocuSign link below). Proposed next meeting: Thu 10/21 10:00am CEST to align technical scope and sign pilot form.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

- Procurement asks: can the pilot paperwork be a short MSA + SOW instead of a full enterprise contract? We have a compressed procurement review for pilots.
